# telnyx_mobile_phone_number (Resource)

A mobile phone number in your account, with its voice settings (call forwarding, recording, CNAM, interception apps). Create adopts a number you already own. The API cannot delete mobile numbers, so destroy only removes the number from Terraform state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mobile_phone_number_id` (String) The mobile phone number id.

### Optional

- `call_forwarding` (Attributes) Call forwarding settings of the number. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--call_forwarding))
- `call_recording` (Attributes) Recording settings for inbound calls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--call_recording))
- `caller_id_name_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if caller ID name is enabled.
- `cnam_listing` (Attributes) Caller ID name (CNAM) listing settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cnam_listing))
- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the connection associated with this number.
- `customer_reference` (String) A customer reference string.
- `inbound` (Attributes) Settings for inbound calls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inbound))
- `inbound_call_screening` (String) The inbound call screening setting. One of `disabled`, `flag_calls`, `reject_calls`.
- `noise_suppression` (Boolean) The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `outbound` (Attributes) Settings for outbound calls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound))
- `tags` (Set of String) A list of tags associated with the number.

### Read-Only

- `connection_name` (String) The name of the connection.
- `connection_type` (String) The type of the connection.
- `country_iso_alpha2` (String) The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the number.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the mobile phone number.
- `mobile_voice_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if mobile voice is enabled.
- `phone_number` (String) The +E.164-formatted phone number.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `sim_card_id` (String) The ID of the SIM card associated with this number.
- `status` (String) The status of the phone number.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--call_forwarding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `call_forwarding`

Optional:

- `call_forwarding_enabled` (Boolean) Whether calls to the number are forwarded.
- `forwarding_type` (String) When calls are forwarded: `always`, or `on-failure` when the call cannot be connected. One of `always`, `on-failure`.
- `forwards_to` (String) The +E.164 number calls are forwarded to.


<a id="nestedatt--call_recording"></a>
### Nested Schema for `call_recording`

Optional:

- `inbound_call_recording_channels` (String) Whether recordings have one channel or a separate channel per party. One of `dual`, `single`.
- `inbound_call_recording_enabled` (Boolean) Whether inbound calls are recorded.
- `inbound_call_recording_format` (String) The audio format of recordings. One of `mp3`, `wav`.


<a id="nestedatt--cnam_listing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cnam_listing`

Optional:

- `cnam_listing_details` (String) The caller ID name to list.
- `cnam_listing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether a CNAM listing is published for the number.


<a id="nestedatt--inbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inbound`

Optional:

- `interception_app_id` (String) The ID of the app that will intercept inbound calls.

Read-Only:

- `interception_app_name` (String) The name of the app that will intercept inbound calls.


<a id="nestedatt--outbound"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outbound`

Optional:

- `interception_app_id` (String) The ID of the app that will intercept outbound calls.

Read-Only:

- `interception_app_name` (String) The name of the app that will intercept outbound calls.
